prompt: In a Clean Architecture mobile app, which layer should contain zero references to platform framework classes (no Retrofit, Room, UIKit, etc.)?
choices: Presentation layer
Domain layer
Data layer

prompt: In the Order History example, why does OrderRepository exist as an interface in the domain layer with its implementation in the data layer?
choices: To satisfy a build system requirement that interfaces be declared as data classes
So the domain layer depends only on an abstraction it owns, and the data layer can be swapped (e.g. REST to GraphQL) without touching the use case
Because Hilt requires every repository to be declared as an interface
To make the repository automatically thread-safe

It builds a package's workspace dependencies first, following the real dependency graph, and skips rebuilding packages whose inputs haven't changed
It automatically deploys packages/core-logic to both apps

prompt: The main cost micro-frontends (e.g. via Webpack Module Federation) introduce that a single-deploy SPA doesn't have is:
choices: An inability to use React
Runtime coordination risk across independently-versioned pieces -- shared dependency mismatches, design-system drift, and composition failures that only appear in production
No way to share any code between teams
A mandatory server-side rendering requirement

prompt: Why does the Hilt example bind OrderRepositoryImpl to the OrderRepository interface with @Binds, rather than having OrderHistoryViewModel instantiate OrderRepositoryImpl directly?
choices: @Binds is required boilerplate with no functional purpose
It lets the ViewModel depend on the abstraction -- testable and swappable -- while Hilt wires the concrete implementation at compile time, the same dependency-inversion idea as the domain/data split
Direct instantiation of a class is forbidden by the Kotlin compiler
@Binds automatically makes the repository a singleton, which @Inject alone cannot do

Native code is always faster than cross-platform code regardless of the feature

choices: Always native, since native is categorically the better choice
